facts.fact: 吊笼下潜时 Henry 抓住栏杆目瞪口呆地看第一层，Petra 爱看游客这一刻的表情
facts.anchor: Henry clutches the lift bars, gaping at the First Layer

facts.fact: 当年鹦鹉在主街爆炸后，被鸟血溅到的人都染上 Void 鹦鹉流感；Petra 一家被邻居传染，只有强壮、健康或付得起治疗费的富人活下来
facts.anchor: Everyone who got hit with the bird’s blood contracted Void parrot flu.

facts.fact: Petra 的弟弟 Mica 六个月大时死于这场流感；Petra 说现在未必救得了他，但至少有得可试，幻想将来开诊所应对下一次疫情
facts.anchor: Mica succumbed to the illness when he was just six months old.

facts.fact: Petra 和 Jade 已接种鹦鹉流感疫苗，她把核桃塞进 Henry 手里让他喂鹦鹉，Henry 很快笑着把一袋核桃扔完
facts.anchor: I put some walnuts in Henry’s hand. “They want you to feed them.”

facts.fact: 吊笼遇到孤儿院十二岁孩子在练攀岩，Jasper 上墙、保护员在下面放绳；Bort 和 Emerald 跳着要 Petra 带好玩的东西回去
facts.anchor: Jasper ascends the wall, securing his rope into the permanent bolts, while his belayer feeds the rope below

facts.fact: Henry 追问父母，Petra 说自己没有父母、Jade 附和，Henry 说「你母亲给了你生命」，Petra 表面答「我们因此更好」，心里补的是「然后她试图卖掉我」
facts.anchor: Some days, I miss my dad. But I’ve had to move on, and all the heartache my parents caused?

facts.fact: Petra 十一岁、父亲死于 Void 与 Mica 死于流感一个月后，和母亲露宿店檐下；母亲向路过男人开口「我有个女儿」，Petra 其实醒着，早已躲到街尾储物棚后面
facts.anchor: I was eleven years old, and it was a month after we found out that Dad had died in the Void

facts.fact: Jade 在巷子里找到 Petra 并把她带进孤儿院；Jade 的父亲想把她塞进报酬全归自己的十年契约船队，她听到后逃跑，父亲后来被捕，两人都不再关心各自父母的下场
facts.anchor: She was the one who found me living in the alley and took me to the orphanage.

facts.fact: Henry 来自 Bramida，想亲手找一颗能照亮整间屋子的 glow gem 送给爱粉色、会弹钢琴的妻子；Jade 借话头说 Petra 也弹琴，Petra 一边假装「oh wow」一边嫉妒又骄傲
facts.anchor: Yes. She loves pink, and she’s heard of the gems from the Void that will light up an entire room.

facts.fact: 过了半英里标记后光线变暗，Petra 给颈腕涂 Stay Alive 遮味剂防 colossal moth，又提醒 Henry 别踩会绞杀小动物的 snagglegrass
facts.anchor: I pull out my roll-on stick of Stay Alive Masking Scent, applying it to my neck and wrists.

facts.fact: Petra 讲蘑菇靠 Void Core 供能发光并产氧，指认四百尺高的红菇 Big Lassy 至少两百岁；她已用 Void 植物做出比父亲更强的药，Ms. Opal 夸她的 lazalia 酊剂胜过医生开的药片
facts.anchor: The first Void divers noted her as being the tallest, and that was back when she was only three hundred feet.

facts.fact: 池塘里一条亮绿鳗被 rare fish trap vine 活活吞食，Petra 打开笔记本记录鱼 trap 吐骨头的现象并剪下几片叶子装包；她要开自己的温室与诊所
facts.anchor: A bright-green eel thrashes in the pond in front of us, being eaten alive

facts.fact: 到通往第二层的 Crag，Petra 修好 Henry 系错的扣、说明用 ascender 把人摇上去，Jade 照例说「I’ll get you back to the top」，Petra 答「We’ll see the sunlight」后蹬壁坠入黑暗
facts.anchor: I hold my hand up, presenting the edge that drops off into pure darkness
